question: Şəbəkədə neçə filial var?
question_en: How many branches does the network have?
sql: SELECT count(*) AS branch_count FROM pharma.branch

question: Bakıda neçə filial var?
question_en: How many branches are in Baku?
sql: SELECT count(*) AS branch_count FROM pharma.branch WHERE city = 'Bakı'

question: Ən bahalı 5 dərman hansılardır?
question_en: Which are the 5 most expensive drugs?
sql: SELECT trade_name, strength, dosage_form, unit_price FROM pharma.drug ORDER BY unit_price DESC LIMIT 5

question: Reseptlə satılan neçə dərman var?
question_en: How many drugs are prescription-only?
sql: SELECT count(*) AS rx_drugs FROM pharma.drug WHERE requires_prescription

question: Hansı istehsalçılar Türkiyədəndir?
question_en: Which manufacturers are from Turkey?
sql: SELECT name FROM pharma.manufacturer WHERE country = 'Türkiyə'

question: Hazırda neçə aktiv işçi var?
question_en: How many active employees are there?
sql: SELECT count(*) AS active_employees FROM pharma.employee WHERE is_active

question: Dərmanların orta qiyməti nə qədərdir?
question_en: What is the average drug price?
sql: SELECT round(avg(unit_price), 2) AS avg_price FROM pharma.drug

question: Sirop formasında olan dərmanları göstər
question_en: Show the drugs that come as a syrup
sql: SELECT trade_name, strength FROM pharma.drug WHERE dosage_form = 'syrup'

question: Bonus balı 100-dən çox olan neçə müştəri var?
question_en: How many customers have more than 100 bonus points?
sql: SELECT count(*) AS customers FROM pharma.customer WHERE bonus_points > 100

question: Bazada neçə həkim var?
question_en: How many doctors are in the database?
sql: SELECT count(*) AS doctors FROM pharma.doctor

question: Kardioloq həkimlərin siyahısı
question_en: List the cardiologists
sql: SELECT first_name, last_name, clinic FROM pharma.doctor WHERE specialty = 'Kardioloq'

question: Vaxtı keçmiş neçə partiya var?
question_en: How many batches have expired?
sql: SELECT count(*) AS expired_batches FROM pharma.batch WHERE expires_on < current_date

question: Gəncədəki filialların adları və ünvanları
question_en: Names and addresses of the branches in Ganja
sql: SELECT name, address FROM pharma.branch WHERE city = 'Gəncə'

question: Paracetamol tərkibli dərmanlar hansılardır?
question_en: Which drugs contain paracetamol?
sql: SELECT trade_name, strength, dosage_form FROM pharma.drug WHERE active_ingredient ILIKE '%paracetamol%'

question: İndiyə qədər neçə satış olub?
question_en: How many sales have been made so far?
sql: SELECT count(*) AS sales FROM pharma.sale

question: Hər kateqoriyada neçə dərman var?
question_en: How many drugs are in each category?
sql: SELECT c.name AS category, count(*) AS drug_count FROM pharma.drug d JOIN pharma.category c ON c.category_id = d.category_id GROUP BY c.name

question: Hər filialda neçə aktiv işçi işləyir?
question_en: How many active employees work in each branch?
sql: SELECT b.name AS branch, count(*) AS employees FROM pharma.employee e JOIN pharma.branch b ON b.branch_id = e.branch_id WHERE e.is_active GROUP BY b.name

question: Hər ölkədən neçə istehsalçı var?
question_en: How many manufacturers are there per country?
sql: SELECT country, count(*) AS manufacturers FROM pharma.manufacturer GROUP BY country

question: Hansı istehsalçı ən çox dərman çeşidi təqdim edir?
question_en: Which manufacturer supplies the most drug products?
sql: SELECT m.name, count(*) AS drug_count FROM pharma.drug d JOIN pharma.manufacturer m ON m.manufacturer_id = d.manufacturer_id GROUP BY m.name ORDER BY drug_count DESC, m.name LIMIT 1

question: Hər şəhər üzrə ümumi xalis gəlir nə qədərdir?
question_en: What is the total net revenue per city?
sql: SELECT b.city, sum(s.net_amount) AS net_revenue FROM pharma.sale s JOIN pharma.branch b ON b.branch_id = s.branch_id GROUP BY b.city

question: Keçən ay neçə satış olub?
question_en: How many sales were made last month?
sql: SELECT count(*) AS sales FROM pharma.sale WHERE pharma.business_date(sold_at) >= (date_trunc('month', current_date) - interval '1 month')::date AND pharma.business_date(sold_at) < date_trunc('month', current_date)::date

question: Bu il miqdarca ən çox satılan 10 dərman
question_en: Top 10 drugs by quantity sold this year
sql: SELECT trade_name, sum(quantity) AS units FROM pharma.v_sale_lines WHERE sale_date >= date_trunc('year', current_date)::date GROUP BY trade_name ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 10

question: Son 6 ayda aylar üzrə xalis gəlir
question_en: Net revenue by month over the last 6 months
sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', pharma.business_date(sold_at))::date AS month, sum(net_amount) AS net_revenue FROM pharma.sale WHERE pharma.business_date(sold_at) >= (date_trunc('month', current_date) - interval '5 months')::date GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question: Filiallar üzrə orta çek məbləği
question_en: Average receipt amount per branch
sql: SELECT b.name AS branch, round(avg(s.net_amount), 2) AS avg_receipt FROM pharma.sale s JOIN pharma.branch b ON b.branch_id = s.branch_id GROUP BY b.name

question: Hansı müştəri ən çox pul xərcləyib?
question_en: Which customer has spent the most money?
sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, sum(s.net_amount) AS total_spent FROM pharma.sale s JOIN pharma.customer c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 1

question: Satışların neçə faizi reseptlə olub?
question_en: What percentage of sales were made with a prescription?
sql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE prescription_id IS NOT NULL) / count(*), 2) AS rx_share_pct FROM pharma.sale

question: Ən çox resept yazan 10 həkim
question_en: The 10 doctors who wrote the most prescriptions
sql: SELECT d.first_name, d.last_name, count(*) AS prescriptions FROM pharma.prescription p JOIN pharma.doctor d ON d.doctor_id = p.doctor_id GROUP BY d.doctor_id, d.first_name, d.last_name ORDER BY prescriptions DESC, d.doctor_id LIMIT 10

question: Yaxın 30 gündə vaxtı bitəcək partiyalar hansı filiallardadır?
question_en: Which branches hold batches that expire within 30 days?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT branch_name FROM pharma.v_expiring_soon

question: BAK01 filialında qalığı minimumdan az olan dərmanlar
question_en: Drugs below minimum stock in branch BAK01
sql: SELECT l.trade_name, l.quantity, l.min_stock FROM pharma.v_low_stock l JOIN pharma.branch b ON b.branch_id = l.branch_id WHERE b.code = 'BAK01'

question: Həftəsonu və iş günlərində satış sayını müqayisə et
question_en: Compare the number of sale lines on weekends and weekdays
sql: SELECT d.is_weekend, count(*) AS sale_lines FROM analytics.fact_sales f JOIN analytics.dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.date_key GROUP BY d.is_weekend

question: Bu il rüblər üzrə xalis gəlir
question_en: Net revenue by quarter this year
sql: SELECT d.quarter, sum(f.net_amount) AS net_revenue FROM analytics.fact_sales f JOIN analytics.dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.date_key WHERE d.year = extract(year FROM current_date) GROUP BY d.quarter ORDER BY d.quarter

question: Müştərilərin yaş qrupları üzrə satış məbləği
question_en: Sales amount by customer age group
sql: SELECT c.age_group, sum(f.net_amount) AS net_revenue FROM analytics.fact_sales f JOIN analytics.dim_customer c ON c.customer_key = f.customer_key GROUP BY c.age_group

question: Hansı dərman forması miqdarca ən çox satılır?
question_en: Which dosage form sells the most units?
sql: SELECT d.dosage_form, sum(si.quantity) AS units FROM pharma.sale_item si JOIN pharma.batch b ON b.batch_id = si.batch_id JOIN pharma.drug d ON d.drug_id = b.drug_id GROUP BY d.dosage_form ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 1

question: Bu il ümumi endirim məbləği nə qədər olub?
question_en: What is the total discount given this year?
sql: SELECT sum(discount_amount) AS total_discount FROM pharma.sale WHERE pharma.business_date(sold_at) >= date_trunc('year', current_date)::date

question: Satış sayına görə ən yaxşı 5 işçi
question_en: Top 5 employees by number of sales
sql: SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, count(*) AS sales FROM pharma.sale s JOIN pharma.employee e ON e.employee_id = s.employee_id GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name ORDER BY sales DESC, e.employee_id LIMIT 5

question: Son 7 gündə gündəlik satış sayı
question_en: Daily number of sales over the last 7 days
sql: SELECT pharma.business_date(sold_at) AS day, count(*) AS sales FROM pharma.sale WHERE pharma.business_date(sold_at) >= current_date - 7 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question: Bu il ən az gəlir gətirən filial hansıdır?
question_en: Which branch brought in the least revenue this year?
sql: SELECT b.name, sum(s.net_amount) AS net_revenue FROM pharma.sale s JOIN pharma.branch b ON b.branch_id = s.branch_id WHERE pharma.business_date(s.sold_at) >= date_trunc('year', current_date)::date GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY net_revenue ASC LIMIT 1

question: Kateqoriyalar üzrə orta dərman qiyməti
question_en: Average drug price per category
sql: SELECT c.name AS category, round(avg(d.unit_price), 2) AS avg_price FROM pharma.drug d JOIN pharma.category c ON c.category_id = d.category_id GROUP BY c.name

question: Hansı həkim ixtisası ən çox resept yazıb?
question_en: Which medical specialty wrote the most prescriptions?
sql: SELECT d.specialty, count(*) AS prescriptions FROM pharma.prescription p JOIN pharma.doctor d ON d.doctor_id = p.doctor_id GROUP BY d.specialty ORDER BY prescriptions DESC LIMIT 1

question: Vəzifələr üzrə orta maaş
question_en: Average salary by job position
sql: SELECT jp.name AS position, round(avg(e.salary), 2) AS avg_salary FROM pharma.employee e JOIN pharma.job_position jp ON jp.position_id = e.position_id GROUP BY jp.name

question: Qadın və kişi müştərilərin orta çek məbləği
question_en: Average receipt amount of female and male customers
sql: SELECT c.gender, round(avg(s.net_amount), 2) AS avg_receipt FROM pharma.sale s JOIN pharma.customer c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id GROUP BY c.gender

question: Hansı filialda ən çox reseptli satış olub?
question_en: Which branch made the most prescription sales?
sql: SELECT b.name, count(*) AS rx_sales FROM pharma.sale s JOIN pharma.branch b ON b.branch_id = s.branch_id WHERE s.prescription_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY rx_sales DESC LIMIT 1

question: İstehsalçı ölkələri üzrə bu ilki satış məbləği
question_en: Sales amount by manufacturer country this year
sql: SELECT dd.manufacturer_country, sum(f.net_amount) AS net_revenue FROM analytics.fact_sales f JOIN analytics.dim_drug dd ON dd.drug_key = f.drug_key JOIN analytics.dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.date_key WHERE d.year = extract(year FROM current_date) GROUP BY dd.manufacturer_country

question: Filiallar arası neçə köçürmə edilib?
question_en: How many transfers between branches have been made?
sql: SELECT count(*) AS transfers FROM pharma.stock_transfer

question: Bir çekdə orta hesabla neçə sətir olur?
question_en: How many lines does a receipt have on average?
sql: SELECT round(avg(n), 2) AS avg_lines FROM (SELECT count(*) AS n FROM pharma.sale_item GROUP BY sale_id, sold_at) t

question: Antibiotiklər qrupunun (alt kateqoriyalar daxil) bu ilki satış məbləği
question_en: This year's sales amount of the antibiotics group, subcategories included
sql: SELECT sum(si.quantity * si.unit_price) AS revenue FROM pharma.sale_item si JOIN pharma.batch b ON b.batch_id = si.batch_id JOIN pharma.drug d ON d.drug_id = b.drug_id JOIN pharma.category c ON c.category_id = d.category_id LEFT JOIN pharma.category p ON p.category_id = c.parent_id WHERE (c.name = 'Antibiotiklər' OR p.name = 'Antibiotiklər') AND pharma.business_date(si.sold_at) >= date_trunc('year', current_date)::date

question: Hər filialda ən çox satılan dərman hansıdır?
question_en: What is the best-selling drug in each branch?
sql: SELECT branch_name, trade_name, units FROM (SELECT branch_name, trade_name, sum(quantity) AS units, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY branch_name ORDER BY sum(quantity) DESC) AS rnk FROM pharma.v_sale_lines GROUP BY branch_name, trade_name) t WHERE rnk = 1

question: Son 12 ayda aylıq gəlirin əvvəlki aya görə faizlə dəyişməsi
question_en: Month-over-month revenue change in percent over the last 12 months
sql: WITH m AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', pharma.business_date(sold_at))::date AS month, sum(net_amount) AS revenue FROM pharma.sale WHERE pharma.business_date(sold_at) >= (date_trunc('month', current_date) - interval '12 months')::date GROUP BY 1) SELECT month, revenue, round(100 * (revenue - lag(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)) / lag(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month), 2) AS change_pct FROM m ORDER BY month

question: Son 7 gündə heç satılmamış dərmanlar
question_en: Drugs that have not been sold at all in the last 7 days
sql: SELECT d.trade_name, d.strength, d.dosage_form FROM pharma.drug d WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pharma.sale_item si JOIN pharma.batch b ON b.batch_id = si.batch_id WHERE b.drug_id = d.drug_id AND pharma.business_date(si.sold_at) >= current_date - 7)

question: Vaxtı keçmiş, amma anbarda qalan dərmanların filiallar üzrə ümumi dəyəri
question_en: Total value of expired stock still on the shelves, per branch
sql: SELECT br.name AS branch, sum(st.quantity * d.unit_price) AS expired_value FROM pharma.stock st JOIN pharma.batch b ON b.batch_id = st.batch_id JOIN pharma.drug d ON d.drug_id = b.drug_id JOIN pharma.branch br ON br.branch_id = st.branch_id WHERE b.expires_on < current_date AND st.quantity > 0 GROUP BY br.name

question: Müştərilərin neçə faizi birdən çox alış edib?
question_en: What percentage of customers made more than one purchase?
sql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE n > 1) / count(*), 2) AS repeat_pct FROM (SELECT customer_id, count(*) AS n FROM pharma.sale WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY customer_id) t

question: Hər şəhərdə ən çox gəlir gətirən filial
question_en: The highest-revenue branch in each city
sql: SELECT city, name, revenue FROM (SELECT b.city, b.name, sum(s.net_amount) AS revenue, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY b.city ORDER BY sum(s.net_amount) DESC) AS rnk FROM pharma.sale s JOIN pharma.branch b ON b.branch_id = s.branch_id GROUP BY b.city, b.name) t WHERE rnk = 1

question: Bu il Bakı filiallarının gəlirini Bakıdan kənar filiallarla müqayisə et
question_en: Compare this year's revenue of Baku branches with branches outside Baku
sql: SELECT CASE WHEN b.city = 'Bakı' THEN 'Bakı' ELSE 'Regionlar' END AS region, sum(s.net_amount) AS net_revenue FROM pharma.sale s JOIN pharma.branch b ON b.branch_id = s.branch_id WHERE pharma.business_date(s.sold_at) >= date_trunc('year', current_date)::date GROUP BY 1

question: Bu ayın satış sayını keçən ilin eyni ayı ilə müqayisə et
question_en: Compare this month's number of sales with the same month last year
sql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE pharma.business_date(sold_at) >= date_trunc('month', current_date)::date) AS this_month, count(*) FILTER (WHERE pharma.business_date(sold_at) >= (date_trunc('month', current_date) - interval '1 year')::date AND pharma.business_date(sold_at) < (date_trunc('month', current_date) - interval '11 months')::date) AS same_month_last_year FROM pharma.sale

question: Gəncə filiallarında bu il neçə ədəd antibiotik satılıb?
question_en: How many antibiotic units were sold in Ganja branches this year?
sql: SELECT sum(si.quantity) AS units FROM pharma.sale_item si JOIN pharma.sale s ON s.sale_id = si.sale_id AND s.sold_at = si.sold_at JOIN pharma.branch br ON br.branch_id = s.branch_id JOIN pharma.batch b ON b.batch_id = si.batch_id JOIN pharma.drug d ON d.drug_id = b.drug_id JOIN pharma.category c ON c.category_id = d.category_id LEFT JOIN pharma.category p ON p.category_id = c.parent_id WHERE br.city = 'Gəncə' AND (c.name = 'Antibiotiklər' OR p.name = 'Antibiotiklər') AND pharma.business_date(si.sold_at) >= date_trunc('year', current_date)::date

question: Bonus balı ən yüksək 10 müştəri və onların ümumi alış məbləği
question_en: The 10 customers with the most bonus points and their total spending
sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, c.bonus_points, coalesce(sum(s.net_amount), 0) AS total_spent FROM pharma.customer c LEFT JOIN pharma.sale s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.bonus_points ORDER BY c.bonus_points DESC, c.customer_id LIMIT 10

question: Hər filial üzrə satılan məhsulların neçə faizi reseptli dərmanlardır?
question_en: Per branch, what share of units sold are prescription drugs?
sql: SELECT branch_name, round(100.0 * sum(quantity) FILTER (WHERE d.requires_prescription) / sum(quantity), 2) AS rx_units_pct FROM pharma.v_sale_lines v JOIN pharma.drug d ON d.drug_id = v.drug_id GROUP BY branch_name

question: Son 3 ayın hər birində ən çox gəlir gətirən gün
question_en: The highest-revenue day in each of the last 3 months
sql: SELECT month, day, revenue FROM (SELECT date_trunc('month', pharma.business_date(sold_at))::date AS month, pharma.business_date(sold_at) AS day, sum(net_amount) AS revenue, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY date_trunc('month', pharma.business_date(sold_at)) ORDER BY sum(net_amount) DESC) AS rnk FROM pharma.sale WHERE pharma.business_date(sold_at) >= (date_trunc('month', current_date) - interval '2 months')::date GROUP BY 1, 2) t WHERE rnk = 1

question: Ən çox köçürmə alan filial hansıdır?
question_en: Which branch received the most transfers?
sql: SELECT b.name, count(*) AS transfers_in FROM pharma.stock_transfer t JOIN pharma.branch b ON b.branch_id = t.to_branch_id GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY transfers_in DESC LIMIT 1

question: Qış aylarında (dekabr-fevral) soyuqdəymə dərmanlarının satış miqdarı yay aylarından neçə dəfə çoxdur?
question_en: How many times more cold-and-cough units are sold in winter (Dec-Feb) than in summer (Jun-Aug)?
sql: SELECT round(sum(f.quantity) FILTER (WHERE d.month IN (12, 1, 2))::numeric / nullif(sum(f.quantity) FILTER (WHERE d.month IN (6, 7, 8)), 0), 2) AS winter_to_summer_ratio FROM analytics.fact_sales f JOIN analytics.dim_date d ON d.date_key = f.date_key JOIN analytics.dim_drug dd ON dd.drug_key = f.drug_key WHERE dd.category_name = 'Soyuqdəymə və öskürək'
